extracted.intended_audience: patent attorneys, judges, and law students (U.S. patent practice)
extracted.subtask_description: An indexed excerpt from a comprehensive U.S. patent law treatise listing legal standards, procedural rules, and substantive criteria relating to patents, pleadings, evidence, remedies, and court practice. It is a reference for practitioners and students on how courts treat various patent-law issues.
